text:
mike-support: FYI HelixAnalytics hit an embed mismatch during last night's ingest — vectors not matching recently indexed rows. Search results are drifting and duplicates showing up. They flagged renewal in 2 weeks. Need CS takeover. Logs: s3://redwood/helix/ingest/2026-03-20/xyz

sarah-cs: on it. tagging @jasmine-cs to lead. what's customer-visible impact? can we scope rollback or fast remediation?

jasmine-cs: taking lead. can we get a short impact summary + ETA to fix? I'll schedule a customer call today. @ana-sales please loop in renewal owner.

mike-support: impact ~30% of queries returning stale vectors, avg +0.8s latency on affected queries. Repro: run embed job with model v1.2.3 and compare id->vector mapping. Suspect race in chunked upload. Log excerpt: ```ERROR: vector_id mismatch batch=42 job=ingest-worker-7```

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-42 — sev:high — owner: eng-runtime

vince-cs: propose comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement to customer, 2) break-fix attempt (ingest retry with throttling) ETA 3-4h, 3) follow-up call + exec summary, 4) postmortem + credits if SLA impacted. I'll draft the note. :white_check_mark:

jasmine-cs: timeline from eng: triage now, hotfix branch open, QA estimate 2h, deploy+verify 1h. If all good, customer call 16:30 PT. Can someone book?

ana-sales: booked 16:30 PT with Helix (calendar invite sent). Added renewal owner @maria-rev to the invite.

mike-support: I pushed a retry script: `python tools/retry_ingest.py --customer helixanalytics --batch 42`

sarah-cs: jasmine — please send the customer note template and assign follow-up owner. Also capture feedback for docs/sync.

jasmine-cs: draft customer note: "We're aware of an embedding ingestion issue affecting a subset of your recent uploads. Our team is actively rolling a fix — ETA 4 hours. We'll call at 16:30 PT to walk through impact and next steps. Apologies for the disruption." Thoughts? :wave:

ana-sales: looks good. Add a line about partnership and that we'll consider a renewal pause while we remediate.

jasmine-cs: updated and sent. I'll post customer response in thread.

mike-support: after running retry, batch 42 reprocessed and vectors realigned. Verification shows ~98% pass. Pushed verification logs to s3://redwood/helix/ingest/2026-03-20/verify.log

jasmine-cs: calling customer early to share the fix. Will post minutes after the call.

jasmine-cs: Customer call notes: they were concerned about search accuracy and business QA. They accepted the fix, asked for longer retention on logs, and requested a 1-week extension on renewal to finalize legal. Customer happy with a credits offer for the disruption. Next steps: 1) draft postmortem 2) QA next nightly ingest 3) update onboarding docs about chunked uploads. Owners: jasmine-cs, eng-runtime, docs.

sarah-cs: great — tagging @maria-rev to approve renewal extension.

maria-rev: approved 1-week extension. Please escalate if any regression occurs.

jasmine-cs: closing loop here. I'll attach the postmortem link once it's published. Thanks everyone. :pray:
